A Setext heading with a stray run `
===
Outside the heading, this can't be hidden. `

>     pasted output that can't be edited

Outside the quoted code, this wasn't hidden either.

> A quoted paragraph
still continues lazily, so this isn't counted.

Nothing at the margin contracts.
